???: Aaah!
I kicked her off me! Now I gotta run for the door!
Yes! I’m already opening the lock!
???: Ha… Hahahaha!
Her laugh… just froze my blood. Why is she laughing?
I turned around and…
???: When you said {f_botName}, you meant her, right?
You: …
She’s pointing her knife at my sexbot… 
???: HaHAHAa You really are pathetic! Crying for help of a fucking doll! 
You: S-shut up! Look! I already unlocked the door! I’m gonna run away and get your ass locked up, psycho!
???: Oh really? Then I’m gonna cut this bitch, you alright with that? 
You: Huh? W-why would you do that? 
???: Because you care about her, you dumbass. You will be done without her! Your career is over! You will die on a street like some hobo hahaha!
???: So what? You gonna run, or defend her?
I-I never thought about it, but she’s right… 
If she destroys {f_botName} I’m gonna end up with nothing. 
Besides…
Do I even have any other person in my life? Well, she is not exactly a human, but she’s close enough. I’m talking to her more than anyone else and she cares about me.
I told her not to move or speak when there are other people nearby so we won’t get caught. I never thought something like this would happen!
So… what should I do…
